# Miso Orthodontic Studio

> Orthodontic and airway-focused practice in Jersey City, New Jersey, led by Dr. Richard Song, DDS. Known for MARPE (mini-screw assisted palatal expansion) in adults, clear aligners, early treatment for children, and TMJ care.

Miso ("미소") is the Korean word for smile. The practice treats orthodontics as facial and airway development rather than cosmetic tooth alignment: every consultation includes a 3D scan and an airway analysis.

## Key facts
- Doctor: Dr. Richard Song, DDS — sees every patient personally, start to finish.
- Signature treatment: MARPE, bone-anchored palatal expansion that widens the adult upper jaw without jaw surgery.
- Services: MARPE and airway expansion, clear aligners (Invisalign), early/interceptive treatment from age seven, TMJ and jaw comfort, whitening and finishing.
- Location: 175 Newark Avenue, Suite 3A-1, Jersey City, NJ 07310. Phone: (201) 377-3757. Fax: (201) 377-3938.
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00–18:00; Saturday by request.
